source_snapshot.criteria: Check BMC SEL log and system status.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 10 attended/10 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; physical water stimulus by operator, then SEL and chassis-status collection.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/CRITICAL; prohibits improvised water on live hardware and requires a vendor-approved simulator/fluid method, containment and recovery.

old_problem: The source directs an undefined water stimulus near hardware and supplies neither a leak-cable/channel map nor an authoritative assertion/deassertion event, protective power response, safe fluid/fixture boundary, dry-out criterion or recovery procedure.
disposition_reason: ED-09 keeps the physical action with a qualified operator, but it does not authorize ordinary water or invent this platform's leak circuit, protective policy or re-energization criteria. These are core OEM safety semantics rather than harmless runtime identifiers, so parameterization cannot close the review decision.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2246, same-row DeepSeek fields, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next row 2247 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00029-V001 / b911f120a0847078 was directly read.

Preserve end-to-end physical leak-cable coverage: exact zone/channel, controlled stimulus, sensor assertion, decoded SEL, documented protective system/power response, deassertion and safe final state.
A qualified operator must perform the physical stimulus and dryness inspection; automation may only collect timestamped read-only BMC/host evidence.
Ordinary water on energized hardware is not an acceptable inferred method. A vendor-approved simulator or bounded fluid procedure must state whether it exercises the physical cable coverage.
The OEM/project owner must define expected event payload/timing and pump/valve/chassis/host behavior; generic IPMI or Linux references cannot determine them.
Containment, electrical isolation, aborts, dry-out/re-energization criteria and damage/recovery ownership must be signed before execution.
No liquid, simulator, power control, log clearing, re-energization, retry or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: Controlled physical liquid-leak protection and recovery
test_case.purpose: Verify the intended physical leak cable and the complete OEM protection path from a controlled stimulus through sensor/SEL assertion, documented protective power behavior, deassertion and safe recovery.
required_package: SUT/BMC/firmware and physical leak cable/zone/channel map
OEM-approved simulator or test fluid with quantity/contact/dwell/removal procedure and physical-coverage statement
Expected sensor state, decoded SEL assertion/deassertion payload/timing and host/pump/valve/chassis response
Qualified operator, containment/PPE/ESD/electrical isolation, abort, dry-out/re-energization and recovery plan
test_case.test_command: No autonomous stimulus command. After all gates are approved, a qualified operator applies the exact OEM-approved bounded stimulus to the mapped cable while the reviewer captures complete timestamped sensor, SEL, chassis-power, host-console and physical evidence without clearing logs.
test_case.expected_result: The mapped leak sensor asserts within the approved interval, emits the exact OEM-defined SEL/event, produces only the documented protective system/power response, deasserts after approved removal/dry-out, and reaches the signed safe final state with no damage.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact target/stimulus authorization, mapped assertion and decoded event, documented protective response, approved deassertion/dryness and safe recovery. A generic SEL line or shutdown alone cannot pass. Any missing OEM oracle or safe recovery keeps execution BLOCKED and the engineering decision pending.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until OEM stimulus, topology, response oracle, containment, isolation and recovery are signed.
Never improvise ordinary water on or near energized electronics.
Qualified operator controls stimulus, physical containment, dryness and re-energization.
Stop on escape, short, odor, heat, unexpected power action, unmapped event or hardware damage; never retry automatically.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and sensor cable/zone/channel photographs/map
OEM stimulus/fixture/fluid procedure, bounds and approval
Dry baseline plus full SEL/sensor/chassis/host state
Stimulus timestamp, sensor assertion and decoded SEL payload/timing
Expected-versus-observed pump/valve/chassis/host response and independent console timeline
Removal, dryness approval, deassertion, damage inspection, final health and recovery record
test_case.recovery: Do not re-energize or repeat after any abnormality. Preserve physical and telemetry evidence, isolate power/liquid per the signed procedure, and let the authorized hardware owner inspect, dry and recover the platform.

source_conflict.reason: The procedure and criteria consistently request physical leak stimulation plus SEL/system checks; the defect is missing safety and OEM acceptance semantics, not contradiction.

blocked.reason: Review is complete, but execution is safety-blocked until an OEM-approved stimulus, authoritative event/power oracle and recoverable dry-state procedure exist.
